description: Answers about the x402 agent-payments market from the whole Bazaar index and Base chain history. action=recommend: which x402 API to call for a need, ranked by fit, price and trust ($0.01). seller_check: is an x402 endpoint / seller trustworthy, its prices and payers ($0.01). payer_profile: a Base wallet's x402 payments, sellers and counterparties up to 3 hops ($0.03). seller_customers: who pays a seller and how much ($0.05). payments_feed: a wallet's payments in time order, with a cursor ($0.005). Bazaar index refreshed every 6 h; chain data real time. Paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana) per call; failed or empty calls are never charged.

action.description: Which question to answer (sets the price, see above).

need.description: recommend: the task in plain words, e.g. 'weather forecast for a city'.

seller.description: seller_customers: seller host or payTo address.

since.description: payments_feed: ISO time cursor from the previous response.

url.description: seller_check: endpoint URL, host or payTo address.

name: x402_lookup
title: x402 market intelligence (which API to call, who pays whom)
